content: {"praised":["Colin Farrell delivers strong, authentic performance as Bozz.","16mm cinematography gives documentary-like, gritty realism.","Simple, understated storytelling keeps audience engaged.","Film explores themes of leadership and redemption.","Tone balances war grit with personal growth."],"criticized":["Story lacks realism, misrepresents military training.","Characters feel cardboard, no development.","Action is plodding, almost static.","Film is boring, fails to maintain pace.","Portrayed as propaganda, lacking depth."]}
